title: fix(types): `PageNodeSchema.body` admits one node or a list, and the reader’s cast goes (objectui#8310)
body:
Fixes #8310

Executes the director-seat ruling recorded on that card (summon #17, decision batch #2,
2026-09-07, maintainer verbatim 「同意」), item by item: `PageNodeSchema.body` declares
`SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]` on **both faces**, `FlatContent`'s `content as SchemaNode` cast
is deleted, the root README's flagship example stays **exactly as written** and is pinned
legal against the declared type, and the changeset is `minor` for `@object-ui/types`.
Options B (narrow the runtime and migrate stored pages) and C (staged retirement) were
refused by that ruling and are not attempted here.

## What changed

| file | change |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/layout.ts` | `PageNodeSchema.body` — `SchemaNode[]` becomes `SchemaNode \| SchemaNode[]` |
| `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` | the mirror — `z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)` becomes `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])` |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` | `[content as SchemaNode]` becomes `[content]` — the declaration now admits what the reader always accepted |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-body-arity-8310.test.ts` | the pin (new) |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-body-single-node-8310.test.tsx` | the render control (new) |
| `.changeset/8310-page-node-body-arity.md` | `@object-ui/types: minor` |

Purely additive: every `body` that was legal before is legal now, and no runtime behaviour
moves — the cast is erased at compile time, so the emitted JS is byte-identical.

## The independent evidence, re-derived rather than quoted

`PageNodeSchema.body` was the **outlier inside its own file**. Anchors re-derived on this
branch's `origin/main` base rather than copied from the card (every seat's line numbers on
that card were that seat's own reading, and none of them matches today's tree):

```
packages/types/src/layout.ts   CardSchema.body          body?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];
packages/types/src/layout.ts   AspectRatioSchema.body   body?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];
packages/types/src/layout.ts   PageNodeSchema.body      body?: SchemaNode[];        <-- the outlier
packages/types/src/base.ts     BaseSchema.body          body?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];
```

Two sibling declarations in the same file already spelled `body` as the union, and so did
the parent channel `PageNodeSchema` inherits. The mirror was the same story:
`CardSchema` and `AspectRatioSchema` spell the union in `layout.zod.ts`; the page node did
not.

## ⚠️ The ceiling — stated because it bounds what this PR buys

`BaseSchema` carries `[key: string]: any`. A type annotation on an authored page therefore
catches a value of the **wrong type** and **never a misspelled key**. Measured, three legs,
on the committed tree (this is the earlier `domain:devx` seat's reading, reproduced here as
the reason the claim is bounded):

| leg | mutation on the annotated literal | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| is the block compiled at all? | `value: zzzUndefinedIdentifier` | exit 1, TS2304 |
| **the ceiling** | `zzzUndeclaredKeyNobodyDeclares: 'x'` | exit 0, **zero diagnostics** |
| the capability | `readOnly: 'not-a-boolean'` | exit 1, TS2322 |

⇒ This PR repairs the **arity of one declared key**. It does **not** make the page node a
closed surface, and nothing here should be quoted as if it did. The bound is written into
the declaration's own docblock so the next reader meets it there too.

## Discriminating power — the pin is red before the widening, green after

Ablation on the committed tree, each leg proved on disk by blob hash before any result was
read, and each restored by state (`git diff HEAD` empty plus a blob-hash comparison against
the `HEAD` blob), not by exit code. Runner: `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict quoted
from its own `VERDICT command-exit` line.

| leg | mutation | `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` | the pin, under vitest |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| baseline (this branch) | none | exit 0, 0 diagnostics | 5 passed |
| **A** | TypeScript face narrowed back | exit 2 — **TS2740 on the pin's own `PageNodeSchema` literal** plus two `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet errors | 5 passed (the zod leg is untouched) |
| **B** | zod mirror narrowed back | exit 2 — one `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet error | **2 failed**, 3 passed |
| **C** | both narrowed — the pre-fix tree | exit 2 — **TS2740 on the pin's literal** | **2 failed**, 3 passed |

Leg A, verbatim:

```
packages/types/src/__tests__/page-body-arity-8310.test.ts(110,3): error TS2740: Type 'BaseSchema' is missing the following properties from type 'SchemaNode[]': length, pop, push, concat, and 28 more.
packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts(2843,14): error TS2322: Type '"layout.zod.ts#PageNodeSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts(2862,14): error TS2322: Type '"body"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
```

Leg B, verbatim:

```
packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts(2754,14): error TS2322: Type '"layout.zod.ts#PageNodeSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
```

The two failing tests in legs B and C are exactly the two single-node assertions; the two
that stayed green are the **regression control** (the list arity, legal in both worlds) and
the README-scan leg. ⛔ The control is labelled as a control in the source and is not
offered as evidence — an assertion green in both worlds proves nothing about a change.

Legs A and B also show the **half-repair is caught**: moving one face and not the other
reddens the `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet from either side.

⚠️ One ablation attempt in this run produced a well-formed reading that was **void**: the
mutation never reached the file (shell quoting ate it), the on-disk proof reported
`injected-text count=0` with the blob still equal to its `HEAD` hash, and the `tsc` exit 0
that followed measured nothing. It is recorded rather than quietly re-run, because "the
gate stayed green" and "the mutation never happened" are the same output.

## Verification

Locked runs go through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; every verdict below is that runner's
own `VERDICT command-exit` line, never a bare shell status.

| what | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (compiles the package's tests via `tsconfig.test.json`) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | **164 files, 3199 tests, all passed** |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/` | **253 files, 2322 tests, all passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run lint` | exit 0 (273 warnings, 0 errors) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run lint` | exit 0 (942 warnings, 0 errors — this PR adds 1 `no-explicit-any` warning of a kind that package already carries) |

`packages/types`' full suite includes `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, so the `KNOWN_DRIFT`
ratchet is green with both faces moved — and, per legs A and B above, red with only one.

Gates run on the built tree (36-task build closure from
`node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs --build-filter`, 35 successful):

| gate | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm check:doc-examples` | exit 0 — 125 blocks, 35 compile, 90 fail exactly as their ledger rows declare |
| `pnpm check:doc-snippets` | exit 0 — 638 of 638 blocks judged, 0 failed |
| `pnpm check:doc-types` | exit 0 — 896 `type` literals against 656 registered keys |
| `pnpm check:spec-symbols` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:published-tsconfig-exclude` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:dist-completeness` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | exit 0 — 7088 tracked text files |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 6 changed paths | NOT GOVERNED |
| `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` | **exit 2 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET ⇒ NOT MEASURED** — it reads the console bundle and this run had none. ⛔ Not a red and not a green. It is declared to CI, which builds the console in `performance-budget.yml`; this diff adds and removes no registration. |

Position axis (`stored vs computed`): both carrier classes checked, by anchor and never by
comparing line numbers. `UNGATED_EXAMPLES` in `scripts/check-doc-example-types.mjs` — whose
keys embed line numbers and which the citation census cannot see — carries **no row** for
any file this PR touches, nor for the root README. `scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs`
is byte-identical before and after this change apart from its own HEAD sha and its
scanned-file count (three new files). The `page.tsx` edit is deliberately
**line-count-preserving** because two test files and two docblocks cite that file by line
below the edit point. ⚠️ The strong form (census on a real `git merge --no-ff origin/main`
result tree) reports "Already up to date" — `origin/main` has not moved off this branch's
base — so that run is the degenerate case and is claimed as nothing more.

## 验收备注

- **`Clause-②: yes` — re-checked against the actual diff, not inherited.** Two published
  faces widen: `packages/types` ships `dist/layout.d.ts` (the declaration) and
  `dist/zod/layout.zod.js` (the validator that accepts more than it did). `needs:contract-review`
  is applied to this PR and to the card in the same stroke, ⛔ never ahead of the PR — the
  card was objected to for exactly that pre-application earlier in its life.
- **Filed while building the render pin: objectui#8912.** The README's flagship grid spells
  its child list `items`; `grid` reads `children` and nothing else, so that example draws an
  **empty grid element**. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer`: the `page` wrapper and
  the `grid` element are drawn (firing control) and `getByText('Total Users')` finds nothing.
  Two further teaching surfaces author the same shape. That is a different defect from this
  card — a child key with no reader, versus the arity of `body` — and the ruling here forbids
  touching the README, so it is filed and **not** repaired. The render control transcribes
  the flagship verbatim, `items` and all, and asserts only what `body`'s arity governs; a
  second pair of assertions uses `children` to prove the whole subtree draws through either
  arity. ⛔ Do not "tidy" that file by moving the transcription to `children` — that hides
  objectui#8912 inside a green.
- **noted, not filed:** `containsTitledPageHeader` in `page.tsx` opens with
  `if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) return false`, so the one-`h1` delegation check never walks a
  single-node `body`. Pre-existing and unchanged by this PR (the single-node form was already
  reachable at runtime), and the successor that would meet it is whoever revisits the
  objectui#3434 delegation rule. Not filed: it needs an authored `page:header` sitting
  directly in a bare-node `body`, and no corpus reading was taken here.
- **objectui#8284 is not addressed here** and remains open, as the ruling directs. It asks
  which channel a renderer reads; this card asked the arity of one of them.

## Notes for review

- The changeset is `minor` on `@object-ui/types` only. `@object-ui/components` emits
  byte-identical JavaScript (a removed `as` cast) and exports no changed type, so nothing
  published moves there.
- The declaration's new docblock cites `page.tsx` by symbol name, never by line, so it
  cannot rot the way this card's own citations did.

## Rework round — contract review REWORK (minor), riders F1 / F2 / F6

Head `bee70da68`. Base merged in first (a merge commit, no rebase, no force-push): `origin/main` had moved 13 commits past this branch's base; the merge was clean and every gate below was run on the merged result, not on the old base. The Clause-② declaration above is untouched, and no carrier label was cleared or hung by this seat.

### F1 (required) — two published statements were made false, not one

Both declared `PageNodeSchema.body` array-only, and this PR widened it on both faces. Found by content, not by line number:

| Surface | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/components/layout/page.mdx` — the `page` component reference | `body?: SchemaNode[];` | `body?: SchemaNode \| SchemaNode[];` |
| `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` — the `### PageNodeSchema` property table | `` `SchemaNode[]` `` | `` `SchemaNode \| SchemaNode[]` `` |

The second one was not named in the review. It is the same falsity in the same round, so it is repaired in the same round.

**⚠️ No gate can see either fix.** `content/docs/components/layout/page.mdx` is ledgered at `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs:424` with exactly 1 unparsed block — the very fence carrying the false line — and the table in `schema-reference.md` is prose. `check:doc-fences` is green *by ledger*, and the fix does not change the block count, so its green has no discriminating power on this rider. Verified by reading; stated so rather than implied.

**Surfaces checked and deliberately LEFT, because they are still true or were never this round's to repair:**

- `guide/schema-rendering.md` and the five catalog page JSONs — array-form *examples*. The widening is purely additive, so they stay legal.
- `api/schema-reference.md` `BaseSchema` and `CardSchema` rows, `components/overlay/tooltip.mdx` — already spell the union.
- `components/layout/semantic.mdx`, `components/basic/div.mdx` — verified that `SemanticSchema` and `DivSchema` declare **no `body` of their own**, so theirs comes from `BaseSchema` and has been `SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]` all along. Their `body?: SchemaNode[];` was already imprecise BEFORE this round: pre-existing, not made false here, left alone.
- `guide/layout.md` — says `body: SchemaNode` (single-only). Wrong in the *other* direction, wrong before this round, and made *less* wrong by it. Not this card's.
- `skills/objectui/**` — independently verified to carry no arity statement at all.

### F2 (should add) — the refusal control, and a measurement that contradicts the suggestion

Leg 4 pins the refusal **envelope** — an `invalid_union` issue at path `['body']` — for a non-node object in either arity, rather than the bare falsity of `success`.

**⚠️ The review's suggested fixtures `body: 42` and `body: 'x'` are NOT refused, and asserting they are would pin a contract this repo does not have.** Measured on both faces:

- `packages/types/src/base.ts`: `type SchemaNode = BaseSchema | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`
- `packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts`: `nodeUnionOptions = [BaseSchemaCore, z.string(), z.number(), z.boolean(), z.null(), z.undefined()]`

A primitive **is** a `SchemaNode` here — the text-node convention — so `SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]` admits `42` by construction, exactly as `BaseSchema.body` and `CardSchema.body` already did. A boundary assertion pins that as legal so the block cannot later be "hardened" into a false pin.

`{ type: 'definitely-not-a-node' }` is unusable too, for a different reason: recursion slot 0 holds `BaseSchemaCore` until `zod/index.zod.js` is evaluated and `AnyComponentSchema` after it, so that value is ACCEPTED in the first world and REFUSED in the second — a function of module evaluation order. Measured both ways. An object with **no `type` at all** is refused in both worlds, which is what leg 4 is built on.

**Proof the new assertions can go red** (this is the discriminating-power claim, so it is measured, not asserted). Mutation = exactly the failure mode F2 names, the `body` arm degraded to accept-anything (`z.any()`):

- mutation proved on disk — anchor count 1 to 0, `ABLATION` marker 0 to 1, blob `8dda31fc` to `39272f82`
- under mutation: **3 failed, 6 passed** — the three new refusal assertions RED (`expected true to be false`), every one of the five pre-existing legs plus the boundary assertion still GREEN. That is precisely the gap F2 identified.
- restored via `git checkout HEAD -- ...` under a `trap`, `git diff HEAD` empty

The run also proves the pin resolves the zod schema from **source**, not a stale `dist/`: mutating `src/zod/layout.zod.ts` changed the result.

### F6 — filed, not fixed

**objectui#8923** — unassigned, unlabeled, untyped, as instructed (`domain:*`, priority and type are triage's). Cites this PR and objectui#3434. `containsTitledPageHeader` opens with an early `false` for anything non-array, so a `page:header` handed in as a single-node `body` still draws a duplicate `h1`; the two `as any` casts at that call site are no longer load-bearing. Pre-existing and deliberately NOT repaired here.

### Gate verdicts on the merged tree

All green, exit 0: `check:control-bytes` (7111 files) · `check:doc-fences` · `check:doc-types` (188 docs, 896 type literals) · `check:doc-snippets` (638/638 blocks compile) · `check:doc-examples` · `check:doc-example-readers` · `check:docs-route-closure` · `changeset:check` · `check-changeset-presence` (8 files, 5 published source, 1 changeset) · `check-changeset-overwrite` · `check:governed-queue-guard --test` (**NOT GOVERNED**, 8 paths vs 5 surfaces) · ratchets `lint:coverage` (46/46), `type-check:coverage` (45/46 + 43/43 test projects), `check:lint-rule-coverage`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.

Tests: `packages/types` **164 files / 3203 tests pass**; the arity pin **9 pass** (was 5, +4 this round); the components render control **5 pass**. `@object-ui/types` `type-check` green, and `--listFiles` confirms the pin file is genuinely in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (leg 1 is really enforced, not merely globbed).

`check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` first returned **exit 2 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (unbuilt packages) — neither red nor green. The scoped build they name was run (35/35 tasks) and both were re-run to a real exit 0.

Lint was run as a **proven narrowing**, not a repo-wide scan (that is CI's): population is eslint's own `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`, so the two edited `.md`/`.mdx` files are outside it entirely; `--format json` reports **1 file linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings**; and `eslint.config.js` declares no `projectService` / `project:` / `parserOptions` (grep exit 1, positive control 8 hits), so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
